sentences.text: The gold loan FAQ states that a gold loan is a loan granted against the security of gold ornaments pledged with the Bank, and it says the tenure is up to 12 months. [E7, E8]
The FAQ evidence provided does not state any pre-payment charge for gold loans. [E4, E5, E6, E7, E8]

The in-force UCB directions say that pre-payment charges are not permitted for certain floating-rate loans, but the code findings say the applicability to this case is unknown because borrower, facility, purpose, rate type, sanction date, and related conditions are not established from the facts provided. [E11, E12, E13, E16, E18, R1, R2, R3, R4]
So, from the gold loan FAQ alone, no pre-payment charge is specified for gold loans. [E4, E5, E6, E7, E8]

missing.searched: Gold Loan FAQ paragraphs on charges and the in-force UCB pre-payment charge directions
